**Summary:**
<!-- ≤5 lines plain English. What landed and why a human should care. No file paths, no jargon. -->

**Issue:** Refs: #N · or · Fixes: #N
<!-- Mid-stack / partial: Refs (links the board, does not close). Last PR that finishes Done when: Fixes. Never neither. -->

**Test plan:** <command you ran / what you checked>

**Paid check:** <named gate you ran, e.g. `eval:coach-chat` at end-of-series> · or `skipped — <reason>`  <!-- ADR 0024: never silently dropped -->

**Learning?** durable rule for your area → role doc `## Learnings` one-liner · tradeoff → ADR in `kdb/decisions/` · neither → N/A

**Plan delete?** if this PR finishes the plan → delete `docs/plans/<file>` here · else N/A
